outcome: Creating an element vnode with both innerHTML or textContent and children warns in development rather than silently discarding the children

acceptance_criteria.text: An element vnode created with an innerHTML prop and children produces a development warning naming the prop that wins.

expected_verification.assertion: creating a vnode with { innerHTML } and a child warns, and the message names innerHTML

acceptance_criteria.text: The warning does not fire when there are no children to discard, nor for a component vnode, so ordinary use is unaffected.

expected_verification.assertion: creating a vnode with { innerHTML } and no children produces no warning

data_impact: None. A development-only warning emitted during vnode creation.
security_impact: None directly. It makes an existing footgun louder — children silently discarded next to innerHTML — which is adjacent to how unsanitised innerHTML gets shipped.
rollout: Ships with the package, development builds only; the check is behind __DEV__.
rollback: git revert. Nothing depends on the warning existing.
